info.name: ProcureAI API
info.description:
Run "0. Login" first (saves adminToken, buyerToken, supplierToken). Then run the folders in order: each request saves the IDs the next one needs.
Demo accounts are created on first backend start. Change baseUrl if your backend runs elsewhere.

exec: const b = pm.response.json(); if (b && b.token !== undefined) pm.collectionVariables.set('adminToken', b.token);
const b = pm.response.json(); if (b && b.token !== undefined) pm.collectionVariables.set('buyerToken', b.token);
const b = pm.response.json(); if (b && b.token !== undefined) pm.collectionVariables.set('supplierToken', b.token);
